finding.summary: A valid one-shot autonomy dispatch lease is consumed before autonomous turn admission. If admission or immediate post-admission context construction fails while the controller step remains ADMITTED, AutonomyPlanner later redispatches that same ADMITTED step without incrementing attempts, so deterministic failures can bypass the configured retry budget.
finding.authority_impact: bounded autonomy/recovery causal-lifecycle defect; no second state, identity, memory, truth or effect authority is introduced by the finding

causal_observation: consume_dispatch_prompt validates the live one-shot lease and exact admitted goal-step, then deletes the lease
terminal_hooks.user_prompt performs _admit_dispatch_turn only after that consumption
the dispatch failure path can abort an active lifecycle but does not canonically fail the still-ADMITTED controller step
AutonomyPlanner.prepare_next returns an existing ADMITTED step unchanged, so another nonce can be reserved without retry accounting

unusual_experiment.counter_reality: Consume a valid dispatch nonce, then force failure before an autonomous active turn is successfully established.
unusual_experiment.evidence_scope: synthetic bounded state-machine discriminator derived from exact current source semantics; not exact ClayVerse runtime execution

repair_invariant: After a valid dispatch token has been consumed, every admission/context failure before a successful autonomous canonical turn continuation must terminalize or requeue the exact bound goal-step through the existing AutonomyController state machine. If an autonomous active turn exists it is aborted first; if the same generation/goal/step is still ADMITTED it is failed through the canonical retry path. Stale or changed identity fails closed. Effects are never replayed.
regression_obligations: consumed nonce plus pre-active-turn admission failure fails the exact ADMITTED step
post-active-turn failure performs lifecycle abort plus exact controller failure re-entry
repeated deterministic failures hit the existing retry budget and become BLOCKED
stale generation or changed goal/step cannot be compensated into another state
verified or pending effects are never replayed or reclassified by dispatch compensation
ordinary human prompt/preemption behavior remains unchanged

execution_evidence.reason: No callable authorized Vercel Sandbox create/start/exec action is exposed to this organ; no forbidden fallback was used.

next_exact_gate: Implement the single canonical compensation transition around autonomy dispatch admission, execute focused and adjacent regressions on exact current bytes in an actually-started authorized isolated executor, then continue exact-current full regression and OCI build/startup acceptance.
